- Identity & Access Mgmt (IAC): kimberly_park (will coordinate key rotation docs and RBAC screenshots)
- Runtime isolation / tenant separation: jonas_weber (will provide architecture diagram + tenant boundary logs)
- Telemetry & log retention: marissa_cole (will coordinate log samples and retention policy excerpts)

Action items for Redwood (short):
1) We'll prepare an evidence manifest and share staging S3 paths by EOD 2026-09-14.
2) Kimberly will confirm the minimum PII redaction template we use for sampling.
3) Jonas will scope the runtime logs sample (two 8-hour windows) and surface any redaction concerns.

Question: can you confirm whether your auditors need signed attestations for keystore operations (HSM/KMS) or if exported logs are sufficient? That will affect our KMS audit trail extraction.

I attached a brief scope draft for our internal owners: osprey_scope_draft.md (internal). We'll avoid sharing that outward until owners sign off.

Thanks — I'll loop back once we have the manifest ready.

Marissa — thanks, that owner split looks good. To answer your KMS question: our external assessors prefer a signed attestation for rotation events only when keys are customer-managed; for vendor-managed KMS exports, the audit logs are sufficient. Osprey is using a customer-managed KMS for some enclaves, so we'll need a rotation attestation for those tenants.
